vectors.name: grant-drive-stop
vectors.description: The ordinary path: take a lease, drive, release the stick.

vectors.name: profile-ceiling
vectors.description: Demo profile scales a full-deflection stick down to its 35 % ceiling.

vectors.name: acceleration-ramp
vectors.description: Balanced profile ramps toward the target instead of stepping to it.

vectors.name: lease-expiry-and-rearm
vectors.description: Silence past the timeout stops the robot; queued motion is refused until a zero command re-arms it.

vectors.name: estop-latches
vectors.description: Emergency stop latches, refuses motion, and still needs a re-arm after reset.

vectors.name: ownership-and-sequence
vectors.description: Non-owners, wrong leases, wrong sessions and replayed sequences are all refused.

vectors.name: transport-loss
vectors.description: Losing the link stops the robot and costs a re-arm even after it comes back.

vectors.name: latency-stop-and-recover
vectors.description: Latency past the profile threshold stops the robot, and recovery is announced.

vectors.name: malformed-never-moves
vectors.description: Malformed traffic is recorded and ignored; it cannot refresh a lease.

vectors.name: out-of-contract-values
vectors.description: Values outside the contract are clamped rather than trusted.

vectors.name: instructor-takeover
vectors.description: A fresh grant supersedes the previous holder, and the old driver goes quiet.
